Final scrim and danger button were photographed; title-blank Escape closed delete dialog. Protocol select Escape closed select first and title-blank Escape closed its dialog. A 233-byte name with 58 Unicode U+2028 separators was accepted by the existing Core API, but the UI rendered it as contiguous text and did not trigger internal overflow. It was replaced with the valid natural long name for the final image.
